Package com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener

Class ControlFlowListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.AbstractListener
      • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.ControlFlowListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SimulationListener
    public class ControlFlowListener
extends AbstractListener
    A simulation listener that counts control flow instructions, block visits and block-to-block transitions, resetting its tallies at each simulation start.
